projection.normSquare: RN(RN(RN(q0*q0 + q1*q1) + q2*q2) + q3*q3), each product RN

wiringControls.rationale: fixed identity/null, unequal tilted force-and-moment, nominal reaction yaw, actuator lag, stable-ID permutation, duplicate/missing/stale/nonfinite inputs; no native query is needed to isolate wiring

manufactured.law: prescribed world force [0,0,m*g] and world arm moment [0,0,0]; equal nominal motors give zero reaction yaw; rotor/collective fields are actuator observables, not a native load-law claim

errorNorms.attitude: 2*min(||q-qexact||2,||q+qexact||2); quaternion chord proxy, not exact geodesic angle

manufactured.toleranceAppliesTo: finest grid only; all three endpoint errors retained
manufactured.rationale: 0.01s spans one control period; three exact smooth ODE controls isolate translation, projected quaternion kinematics and motor relaxation. The fixed floor is over 4000 binary64 epsilons at unit scale, accommodating short-chain endpoint and analytic-evaluation rounding. It disables order inference when errors are tiny; tolerances and contraction are qualification checks, not an observed RK order.

retainedCompatibilityEvidence.buffer56: prior evidence retained as provenance; the loader reruns its fixed 56 Buffer shim assertions as infrastructure checks, separately from all scientific stage/native/reference counts

independentSavedEvidenceControls.primaryWitness: coupled-step0-k1; fixed first ID, no favorable-witness search
independentSavedEvidenceControls.staleStageWitness: coupled-step0-k2 nativeInput replaced with k1 input
independentSavedEvidenceControls.bodyMomentNorm: Euclidean error / (m*g*rotorArmRadius), exact inverse quaternion matrix divided by quaternion norm squared; separate from unchanged four native load gates

independentNeighborMembership.scope: checker-only; both arms at relative times 0 and 0.01; no change to producer Grid/Boids steering
independentNeighborMembership.coordinates: each coordinate difference is RN(saved position_i - saved position_j), matching Grid Math.hypot arguments; exact sum of the three squared rounded differences; self excluded; ascending stable IDs
independentNeighborMembership.neighborPredicate: exact sum of squared RN coordinate differences < exact square of the frozen binary64 neighbor radius
independentNeighborMembership.exclusion: qualification fails if abs(distanceSquared - radiusSquared) <= 2^-40 * radiusSquared for any distinct pair at a controller update
independentNeighborMembership.rationale: prospective exclusion around the boundary avoids treating the producer Math.hypot branch as an exact real-distance predicate
